relations: From his initial stance with hands behind his back, he lifts his right heel and raises both hands toward his head.
As he steps his right foot outward to widen his stance, he holds his arms raised above his shoulders.
He lowers his arms and lifts his left foot while keeping his legs apart, then brings his feet together with hands near his hips.
Shifting his weight, he rotates slightly and steps with his left foot, raising his arms to head level before extending them horizontally.
caption: The video captures a man in a black sleeveless shirt and pink graffiti-print shorts standing with his back to the camera in a dance studio with a mirrored wall and wooden floor. He faces the mirror, which reflects his front view and a row of class members. He stands with his feet together and hands behind his back. He lifts his right heel, bends his elbows, and raises both hands toward his head. Stepping his right foot out to widen his stance, he holds his arms raised above his shoulders. He lowers his arms while keeping his legs apart and lifting his left foot, then brings his feet together with his hands resting near his hips. Shifting his weight, he rotates slightly and steps with his left foot. He raises both arms to head level again, legs apart, before extending them horizontally to the sides. The mirror shows his own front view tracking his movements, while the reflected class members stand watching, some holding up phones.
